title: More Chicken, Fewer Growers, Who's Winning?

intro_meme.prompt: A cartoon chicken flexing dramatically on a bodybuilding competition stage under a spotlight, wearing a sequined robe.

outro_meme.prompt: The same flexing cartoon chicken now giving a thumbs up, gesturing toward a glowing 'READ MORE' sign.

sources.fact: Delmarva produced 40.5% more chicken over the last 20 years while the number of growers fell 36.8% to 1,225 and the number of chicken houses fell 11.3%.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Nate, Delmarva making forty percent MORE chicken than twenty years ago.

screen.prompt: A cartoon chicken flexing a giant bicep, a '40.5% MORE' championship belt wrapped around its waist.

lines.voice_instructions: Channel Richard Pryor-style stand-up energy: exasperated, escalating, physically reactive delivery — real gasps, real disbelief, voice cracking on the big number. This is two friends losing it together over something absurd, not a news broadcast. Real cursing where the line calls for it, land every word of it like a punchline, not a warning label.
